name: Tsurugashima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tsurugashima city emblem in blue: a disc with a white stylised crane rising from the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Tsurugashima, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 June 1965.

features.role: Tsurugashima city emblem — a disc with a white stylised crane rising from the bottom
